app.name: vocab-coach
app.tagline: Turn the words you care about into words you actually use.

demo.badgeHint: Fictional demo database: your own data is not shown.

aiBanner.degraded: No AI provider is available right now. The app keeps working without AI: reviews, manual entry and statistics are not affected.
aiBanner.aiOff: AI is turned off. The app works without it; turn a provider back on whenever you like.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: AI providers, study settings and today's AI usage. Changes apply at once, without restarting the app.

ai.title: AI providers
ai.intro: Free tiers only. Keys stay in the .env file on this computer: the app never shows them again and never sends them to the browser.
ai.privacy: Free tiers may use what you send to improve the provider's products. Ollama runs on your own computer and sends nothing out.
ai.demoNote: Demo database: keys, the connection test and the provider order cannot be changed here. Start the app on your own database to set them up.
ai.loadError: The AI status could not be loaded.

state.disabled: Configured, but turned off in the provider order
state.misconfigured: The provider refused the key: check it, then save it again

provider.keyPlaceholderReplace: Paste a new key to replace the saved one
provider.keyHint: Saved in .env on this computer. It is not shown again, even here.
provider.addressHint: The address where Ollama listens. It is saved in .env and not shown again.
provider.removed: Removed. The provider is no longer used.
provider.savedKey: Saved. It is used from now on.
provider.environment: Set by the environment variable {{variable}}, which takes priority over .env. Change or remove it there, then restart the app.

test.runningHint: A test can take up to a minute and a half when the provider is slow.
test.needsCredential: Save a key or an address before testing.
test.incomplete: The provider answered, but not in the expected format ({{seconds}} s). It may work better on the next call.

reasons.network: the provider could not be reached (check the network or that Ollama is running)
reasons.quota: the free quota is used up or the rate limit was hit; try again later
reasons.timeout: the provider took too long to answer

order.title: Provider order
order.intro: The app tries the first provider, then falls back to the next one. A provider that is turned off is never called.
order.allOff: Every provider is turned off: the app will run without AI.

usage.title: AI usage
usage.intro: Calls made by the app, per study day. Free quotas are counted by the providers, not here.
usage.loadError: The AI usage could not be loaded.

general.title: Study settings
general.loadError: The settings could not be loaded.

daily_time_budget_minutes.label: Daily time budget (minutes)
daily_time_budget_minutes.hint: The daily plan fits reviews and new terms into this time.

new_items_per_day.label: New terms per day
new_items_per_day.hint: The most new terms the plan introduces in one day.

target_retention.label: Target retention
target_retention.hint: Chance of remembering a term when it is reviewed (0.90 = 90 %). Higher means more reviews.

timezone.label: Time zone
timezone.hint: An IANA name such as Africa/Douala or Europe/Paris.

day_start_hour.label: Hour the study day starts
day_start_hour.hint: Reviews done before this hour count for the previous day.

consolidation_share.label: Share of a deck to consolidate
consolidation_share.hint: Share of a deck's productive cards that must be consolidated before a consolidation task is proposed (0.80 = 80 %).

consolidation_min_stability_days.label: Stability needed to consolidate (days)
consolidation_min_stability_days.hint: A term counts as consolidated once its productive card is this stable.

home.title: Welcome
home.intro: Your daily session is below: due reviews first, then the new terms of your lists.
home.apiDown: Cannot reach the local server. Is the backend running?

library.title: Library
library.intro: Every word and expression you want to learn. Search, filter, add and edit them here.

quickAdd.title: Quick add
quickAdd.duplicates: Similar terms already exist. Use one of them in this deck, or add yours as a new term.

terms.title: Terms
terms.empty: No term matches. Add one above, or change the filters.

item.noDecks: This term is in no deck.

decks.title: Decks
decks.intro: A deck groups the terms of one list, course or project.
decks.name: Name
decks.deleteConfirm: Delete the deck “{{name}}” and its terms?

import.title: Import a list
import.intro: Paste a Markdown list or pick a .md or .txt file. You will see every line before anything is saved.

input.title: 1. Your list
input.hint: One term per line, optionally “term | sentence where you met it”. Up to {{max}} characters. The file is read in your browser.
input.tooLarge: This text is longer than {{max}} characters. Split it into several imports.
input.fileError: This file could not be read.

preview.title: 2. What was found
preview.counts: {{lines}} lines read · {{importable}} ready · {{ambiguous}} ambiguous · {{duplicates}} with a possible duplicate
preview.rejected: This text cannot be imported. Fix the problem above and preview again.
preview.noRows: No term was found in this text.

header.none: No header found: name the deck below.

rows.title: 3. Check each line
rows.hint: Ambiguous lines (marked ⚠) are left out unless you correct the term or tick “Import anyway”. You can edit any term.
rows.caption: Lines of the list
rows.mustCorrect: Correct the term to import it

target.title: 4. Where to put the terms
target.missing: Choose a deck or give the new one a name.

intake.title: New terms
intake.triage: Wait for triage (I will say which ones I already know)
intake.queued: Go straight to the learning queue

summary.title: Import done
summary.attached_one: {{count}} existing term added to the deck
summary.attached_other: {{count}} existing terms added to the deck
summary.ambiguous_one: {{count}} ambiguous line in the list (imported only if you confirmed or corrected it)
summary.ambiguous_other: {{count}} ambiguous lines in the list (imported only if you confirmed or corrected them)

problem.too_large: The file is too large (limit: 256 KB and 1000 lines).
problem.not_utf8: The file is not UTF-8 text. Save it as UTF-8.
problem.invalid_header: The header is not valid; it was ignored and the list was read anyway.
problem.invalid_header_value: The header value of “{{key}}” must be plain text; it was ignored.
problem.unclosed_header: The header has no closing “---”; the file was read as a plain list.
problem.invalid_deadline: The deadline must be a date written YYYY-MM-DD; it was ignored.
problem.past_deadline: The deadline is in the past.
problem.multiple_separators: More than one “|”: only the first one separates the term from its sentence.
problem.looks_like_definition: Looks like a term followed by a translation or a definition.
problem.looks_like_sentence: Looks like a sentence, not a term. Write “term | sentence”.
problem.nested_item: Indented sub-item: is it a separate term or a note on the term above?
problem.term_too_long: The term is longer than 300 characters.
problem.term_not_in_sentence: The term was not found in its sentence.
problem.duplicate_in_file: Same term as line {{kept_line}}; only that line is imported.
problem.duplicate_exact: This term is already in your library.
problem.duplicate_possible: A similar term is already in your library.
problem.already_in_deck: This term is already in the target deck; it will be skipped.
problem.existing_status_kept: The existing term keeps its status.

triage.title: Sort new terms
triage.intro: For each term, say whether you want to learn it, are not sure, or already know it. Terms you know are not studied.
triage.shortcutHint: Keys 1, 2 and 3 choose for this term.
triage.done: Saved. To learn: {{learn}} · not sure: {{unsure}} · known: {{known}}.
triage.reloaded: Nothing was saved. The list was reloaded: check your choices and save again.

duplicates.title: Duplicates
duplicates.intro: Terms that look like the same word. Choose the one to keep and merge the others into it: decks, sentences and notes are kept.
duplicates.conflictHint: Two terms that both have review cards cannot be merged: archive one of them instead.
duplicates.inverted: The term with review cards was kept.

aiReasons.network: the AI provider could not be reached
aiReasons.quota: the free quota is used up or the rate limit was hit; try again later
aiReasons.timeout: the AI took too long to answer

sheet.hidden: The usage sheet and its exercises are hidden until you open them.
sheet.spoiler: You have not discovered this term yet: opening the sheet gives away the meaning you will be asked to guess.
sheet.none: This term has no usage sheet yet. Write it yourself, or let the AI generate it.
sheet.working: Working… this can take a minute.
sheet.regenerated: A new version was generated. The previous one is kept in the versions.
sheet.superseded: The sheet changed while the AI was working: nothing was replaced.
sheet.skeleton: The AI could not make a full sheet: a sheet to complete by hand was created.

sheet.aiUnavailable: No sheet generated: {{reason}}. You can write it by hand.

enrichment.title: Generate usage sheets
enrichment.intro: The AI writes a usage sheet and its exercises for each term waiting for one, five terms at a time. Without AI, the terms keep waiting and you can write their sheets by hand.
enrichment.includeIncomplete: Also include the sheets to complete (where the AI failed before)
enrichment.nothing: No term is waiting for a usage sheet.
enrichment.working: Batch {{batch}} in progress… a batch can take a few minutes.
enrichment.progress: Generated: {{generated}} · to complete by hand: {{needsCompletion}} · still waiting: {{remaining}}.
enrichment.done: Done: no term is waiting any more.
enrichment.stopped: Stopped. The remaining terms keep waiting.
enrichment.stalled: Nothing could be written in the last batch (the terms changed meanwhile). Try again.
enrichment.skeletons: Some sheets could not be generated in full: tick the box above to list them, then complete them by hand.
enrichment.degraded: Nothing is lost: the terms keep waiting. Open a term below to write its sheet by hand, or set up a provider and try again.
enrichment.listHint: Open a term to write its sheet by hand.
